simple.meaning: אֱנוֹשׁ (ʼĔnôwsh) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line.

timeline.evidenceText: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.
Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

definitions.full: H583. Enosh אֱנוֺשׁ proper name, masculine son of Seth Gen 4:26 ; 5:6-7 , 9 , 10 , 11 ; 1Chr 1:1 . III. אנשׁ ( soft, delicate , compare Arabic , id ., see Lag BN 68 Dl Pr 160 , also below I. אנשׁ ; but compare Nö ZMG 1886, 739 who derives this meaning from feminine ).
